newsitem.title: UK: Biocompatibles touches high on FDA go-ahead.
newsitem.headline: Biocompatibles touches high on FDA go-ahead.

text.p: Shares in Biocompatibles International Plc soared to a record high on Thursday after the UK medical products group received regulatory approval to market its new contact lens in the United States, analysts said.

The U.S. Food and Drug Administration said Biocompatibles had permission, effective immediately, to market its new Proclear Compatibles monthly replacement contact lens, which has already been launched in Britain and Northern Europe.
The stock gained 82-1/2p to trade at 13.75 stg by 1510 GMT, having touched a record high of 13.85 stg earlier in the day. Volume was modest at 440,103 shares.

"It's potentially quite a big product (Proclear) and the U.S. is the world's largest contact lens market, so it's an important announcement for them," said Erling Refsum, pharmaceuticals analyst at Yamaichi International.
Biocompatibles shares have almost tripled in value since early November last year and analysts said the rally looked set to continue for some time.

"They had good results and they gave a good results presentation. They are meeting their targets and getting products on the market and they have plenty to look forward to, so they are doing well," Refsum said.
